sources.scope: Signature fields, complete byte-range coverage except Contents, incremental signed-byte preservation, DocMDP and FieldMDP.

decisions: Original detached DER SignedData with SHA256/RSA-PKCS1, one explicit signer certificate and no synthesized signed attributes or timestamp. Independently verified with OpenSSL and Poppler.
Exact owned Contents reservation and complete revision boundaries, cryptographic self-verification and immutable complete signed bytes.
Only pre-created unlocked-field signing is certified as a permitted source edit profile. Broader generic edits reject unless signature invalidation is explicitly authorized.
Trust/revocation/expiry/identity/PAdES and arbitrary external modification permission validation are distinct from intact CMS.

PKCS12 native import and borrowed store/hardware key execution require complete hostile/native/runtime qualification. The original DER parser authenticates MAC and enforce finite KDF/bag/key profiles before owned RSA parameter import; private PFX data never reaches a native X509 loader or persisted-key fallback.
